text:
maria: Customer reporting intermittent 5xx + timeouts on hosted inference. p95 jumped and customer seeing lots of 502/504s. ticket C-9721. Repro steps pasted below.

alex: Can you drop the exact request + error log? Is this coming through continuous-batcher path?

maria: Yes — they're on chat + continuous batching with long convo. Their curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-open-47b","input":"<very long conversation>","stream":false}'
```
They get intermittent `504 Gateway Timeout` and gateway logs show `depth_limit_exceeded`.

jordan: I see a spike in `queue_depth` metrics around 2026-03-17 13:01-13:04 UTC. continuous-batcher backlog rose sharply; kv-cache miss rate spiked. Trace: https://go/trace/abc123 (internal link)

alex: @kai are you oncall? Any autoscale activity or evictions at that time?

kai: Oncall here. Confirmed: batcher backlog went from ~120ms to ~1.6s. Autoscale did not add nodes — shared hosted pool hit per-tenant depth limiter. Key logs:
```text
ERROR gateway: enqueue failed: depth_limit_exceeded tenant=t-88 queue_depth=100
WARN batcher: eviction_swarm kv_misses=432 backlog=78
```
Looks like many unique prefixes causing KV churn + several longseq requests in parallel.

maria: Customer says this began after they rolled out multistream prompts and ramped parallel long conversations. Also seeing client retries which amplify the spike.

jordan: Probable causal chain: (1) high unique-prefix rate -> KV cache churn -> more kv misses, (2) longer per-request latency -> batcher backlog grows, (3) queue depth limiter kicks -> tail requests get ejected -> gateway returns 5xx/504. Mitigations we can do quickly:
- temporarily raise per-tenant depth limit on hosted pool
- enable fallback to a smaller model variant for that tenant
- enable aggressive prefix caching for similar convo IDs
- advise customer to reduce concurrency / add jitter to retries

alex: I'm going to open an emergency config patch: depth=100 -> 140 for shared hosted pool for 30min and enable tenant fallback to rwd-open-13b. Notifying infra runbook.

kai: Applying patch now. ETA ~5m. Also: adding short-term alert for `depth_limit_exceeded > 5/min`.

maria: I'll message the customer with a quick mitigation: \"We're applying a temporary capacity bump and enabling a fallback model. Please reduce concurrent long requests to <40 and add jitter to retry logic.\" :thumbsup:

ticketbot: Patch applied: 2026-03-17-rc3 -> hosted-shared-pool. depth_limit set to 140 for 30m; tenant fallback enabled. Monitoring enabled.

jordan: Watching metrics — backlog and p95 are trending down now. kv miss rate decreasing.

alex: Followups: add an automated KV-churn detector + autoscale policy for shared pools; add runbook entry for ramping depth safely; schedule retrospective.

maria: Customer updated: errors dropped after patch. Will monitor 2h then close ticket. Thanks all.
